metadata.description: Additional writable VNet properties for API version 2025-07-01. Explicit addressSpace, dhcpOptions and subnets parameters take precedence.

resources.name: [parameters('vnetName')]
resources.properties: [union(parameters('additionalProperties'), createObject('addressSpace', createObject('addressPrefixes', parameters('addressPrefixes')), 'dhcpOptions', createObject('dnsServers', parameters('dnsServers')), 'subnets', parameters('subnets')))]
